newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - February 21.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - February 21.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Family members of China's paramount leader Deng Xiaoping want body of the late Deng cremated
-- Taiwan President Lee Teng-hui asks residents to have confidence in government, sends condolences to Deng's family
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Taiwan Premier Lien Chan urges China to achieve win-win condition for both sides of Taiwan Strait
-- China holds mourning rally on February 25 in memorial for Deng Xiaoping
LIBERTY TIMES - Premier Lien Chan calls for maintenance of stability in the Taiwan Strait
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Premier Lien Chan orders stablizing stock and money markets
-- Asia-Pacific financial markets stable despite Deng's death
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Global financial markets firm despite Deng's death
-- Economic growth rate to reach 6.2 percent for this year
